## 1. Quick Algorithm Matrix

| Algorithm | Input Domain | Space Complexity | Time Complexity | Best Cluster Use Case |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Subtractive Euclid** | $\\mathbb{Z}^+$ | $O(1)$ | $O(\\max(a, b))$ | Historical analysis, simple FPGA logic gates |
| **Standard Modulo Euclid** | $\\mathbb{Z}^+$ | $O(1)$ | $O(\\log(\\min(a, b)))$ | Standard CPU host simulation logic |
| **Stein Binary GCD** | $\\mathbb{Z}^+$ | $O(1)$ | $O(\\log a + \\log b)$ | SIMD / GPU branchless kernel execution |
| **Extended GCD (EEA)** | $\\mathbb{Z}$ | $O(1)$ | $O(\\log(\\min(a, b)))$ | Modular inverse, modular forms |
| **2D Gauss-Lagrange** | $\\mathbb{R}^2$ lattice | $O(1)$ | $O(\\log(\\text{cond}(B)))$ | Solid-state Bravais lattice primitive cell |
| **LLL Reduction** | $\\mathbb{R}^n$ lattice | $O(n^2)$ | Polynomial $O(n^5 \\log^3 B)$ | High-dimensional crystallography, lattice cryptography |

## 2. Low-Level C Intrinsics for Cluster Nodes (`art-1` / `art-16`)

```c
// Extract greatest common divisor with zero hardware division
#include <stdint.h>

static inline uint64_t fast_gcd(uint64_t u, uint64_t v) {
    if (!u || !v) return u | v;
    int shift = __builtin_ctzll(u | v);
    u >>= __builtin_ctzll(u);
    do {
        v >>= __builtin_ctzll(v);
        if (u > v) { uint64_t t = v; v = u; u = t; }
        v -= u;
    } while (v);
    return u << shift;
}
```
